title: ZEBRA: Zero-shot Budgeted Resource Allocation for LLM Orchestration
abstract: arXiv:2605.20485v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As autonomous agents increasingly execute end-to-end tasks under fixed monetary budgets, the pressing open question shifts from whether the budget is respected, to how to spend it effectively. Existing budget-aware methods typically control reasoning step-by-step within a single agent, or learn resource allocation policies via RL. None address how to split a budget across the composing phases of a multi-agent pipeline at inference time. We propose ZEBRA, a zero-shot framework that reduces multi-phase budget allocation to a continuous nonlinear knapsack problem: an LLM controller estimates per-phase utility curves, and a water-filling search on the Lagrange multiplier returns the per-phase split. Additive and multiplicative aggregations are unified under the same solver. translated_title: ZEBRA：面向大语言模型编排的零样本预算化资源分配
translated_abstract: 随着自主智能体越来越多地在固定货币预算下执行端到端任务，紧迫的开放性问题已从预算是否得到遵守，转变为如何有效地花费预算。现有的预算感知方法通常在单个智能体内部逐步控制推理，或通过强化学习学习资源分配策略，但没有一种方法解决在推理时如何将预算划分到多智能体流水线的各个组成阶段。我们提出ZEBRA，这是一个零样本框架，它将多阶段预算分配归约为一个连续非线性背包问题：由一个大语言模型控制器估计每个阶段的效用曲线，并通过对拉格朗日乘子进行注水搜索得到各阶段的预算划分。加性聚合和乘性聚合在同一求解器下得到统一。在一个包含150个任务的APPS编程基准上，ZEBRA的两个变体在所有聚合指标上都优于LLM-direct（即由大语言模型直接进行预算分配）。在预算为$（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: ZEBRA是一个零样本框架，将多智能体流水线的多阶段预算分配归约为连续非线性背包问题，利用大语言模型估计各阶段效用曲线并通过拉格朗日乘子注水搜索求解，在150任务的APPS编程基准上所有聚合指标均优于由LLM直接分配预算的方法。
en_tdlr: ZEBRA is a zero-shot framework that reduces multi-phase budget allocation in multi-agent LLM pipelines to a continuous nonlinear knapsack problem, using an LLM controller to estimate per-phase utility curves and a water-filling search on the Lagrange multiplier to solve it, outperforming direct LLM budget allocation on every aggregate metric of a 150-task APPS coding benchmark.
